scientific_question: How do assumed mass, local reaction delay and hinge stiffness alter the paired effect of neighbor cues on actual airborne motion and bounded actuator work?
status: frozen before batch results; dispatch requires baseline controls and numerical checks
design: seven-point axial sensitivity design; no interaction estimates
endpoint_predicate: Only use actual saved state at0.60000000s within1e-7s; if stopped earlier, endpoint absent and metrics null. Never use final state as substitute.
metrics: min saved center separation (not mesh collision clearance)
time of first/last saved response flag
all model-domain exits and numerical/actuator failures
gate: same frozen max position0.01m and orientation0.03rad at common actual saved times; all bounded actuation checks; no criterion change
uncertainty_basis: All varied envelopes are hand-set engineering assumptions, not measured flying-fish priors. Seeds draw assigned Uniform reaction delays, not biological replicate samples.
dependence: Same v3a geometry/polar and common seed reused across parameter settings and neighbor ablations. Paired comparisons are not independent source confirmations.
source_and_transfer_limits: No CFD/wake/collision model; no water phase; no calibrated nervous system or fish phenotype probability.
partial_policy: Keep every completed scenario, failed numerical case, model-domain exit and unfinished scenario. No replacement settings or adaptive tuning.
